conversation_summary.objective: Build a Laravel 11 + Vue 3 (Composition API) time entry interface with relational validation, performance-aware metadata loading, and keyboard-friendly UX.
major_decisions: Used Laravel + Inertia + Vue 3 Composition API with Tailwind.
Kept authentication scaffold installed but made dashboard publicly accessible to match the requirement that authentication is not required.
Implemented backend-first validation for relational integrity and business rules.
Added metadata caching on the New Entries tab to avoid duplicate API requests per company.
Implemented row-level validation feedback for bulk insert UX.
Added edit flow for existing entries from the History tab using a dedicated modal component and update endpoint.
Added faster data entry utilities (duplicate row and reuse last row values).
Expanded History experience with summary totals, sorting, searching, filtering, and pagination.
implemented_scope: Database schema, models, and relationships (including pivot tables).
Seeders and factories with realistic relational data.
API endpoints for companies, metadata, and time entries (index + bulk store + update).
Dashboard with global company filter and tabbed interface.
New Entries tab with dynamic rows, keyboard support, row duplication/reuse, and row-level error rendering.
History tab with reactive filtering, search, sorting, loading indicator, pagination, summary totals, and edit modal.

messages.content_summary: Requested Laravel 11 + Vue 3 + Vite setup steps and practical terminal guidance.
Provided and executed setup workflow for Laravel, Breeze (Vue), Vite, and initial component structure.
Requested migrations and Eloquent models according to the provided database specification.
Created tables, pivot tables, and model relationships; verified migration success.
Switched from sqlite to MySQL and requested creation of database `time_track`.
Configured `.env`, created MySQL database, and migrated schema after valid credentials were provided.
Requested realistic data seeding with relationship constraints and current-month entries.
Implemented factories and DatabaseSeeder; added guard checks for one-project-per-date rule.
Requested FormRequest validation, business rule enforcement, and controller/resource structure.
Added StoreTimeEntryRequest, TimeEntryController (index/store/getMetaData), and TimeEntryResource with eager loading.
Requested Dashboard, New Entries, and History tabs with global company filter and reactive behavior.
Implemented tab layout, New Entries dynamic table, metadata caching, keyboard UX, History data display/search/sorting/pagination, and summary totals.
Reported runtime/UX issues and requested cleaner output/messages.
Fixed guest layout crash, refined validation messages to use employee names, cleaned unused components, and improved README.
Requested completion of remaining bonus scope including edit entries and faster data entry.
Implemented update endpoint with validation, added History edit modal component, and added duplicate/reuse-row behavior in New Entries.

notes: This file contains summaries and does not include raw credentials, API keys, or private tokens.
